items.html: *And behold, you will see that Atik includes MA and BON, and both are male and female, one Partzuf. And the posteriors of MA and BON are in the middle of this Partzuf, with the face of MA on one side and the face of BON on the other side, and the two aspects of posteriors between them. Arich Anpin, too, is male and female, MA and BON, one Partzuf, but in a different manner, for throughout its right half there is MA in face and posterior, and throughout its left half there is BON in face and posterior.
